// note: Project settings for DevX Nexus. Committed deliberately so every machine behaves the same.
// formatting: There is no Prettier or ESLint config here and the code is hand-formatted. Format-on-save would rewrite thousands of lines the first time anyone saved a file, so it stays off.
// search: node_modules is large and data/ is generated. Excluding them makes search instant and stops you editing a generated file by mistake.
// safety: data/ holds the live JSON database on a local run. Read-only in the editor so a stray keystroke cannot corrupt real orders.
